about: Get ready for an adventure like no other as rookie magicians Bobby and Penny find themselves stuck between dimensions.
As they journey through a variety of enchanting worlds, it’s up to you to help them fight their way back to their own dimension and reclaim the Magic Book.
With catchy music, charming old-timey art, and non-stop comedy, Enchanted Portals is a co-op 2D platformer that will keep you on your toes.
Whether you’re playing solo or with a friend, the magic never stops and the action is always fast-paced and whimsical. Join Bobby and Penny on their quest and see where the adventure takes you!
* A collection of challenging PLATFORM STAGES, set in a variety of worlds across dimensions.
